thread:
mira: Heads-up — nightly perf dashboard alerted on runtime p95/throughput after the 12:10 merge. p95 ~3x baseline on several kernels. https://dash.redwood/example/snap
kevin: saw that too. The timing lines up with merge 8f3c9a4 (PR #4821) which changed batching window calc and kernel scoring weight. Suspect kernel selection shift -> worse tail.
ci-bot: nightly/perf-job :red_circle: throughput -18% vs baseline; p95 latency +210ms; job id: nightly-34275
olga: can someone bisect? if kernel scoring change is culprit we should see delta when toggling the scoring flag.
mira: starting a quick bisect on a smaller perf harness (only small prompt distribution) — skipping long evals to narrow signal. will post results.
jamal: FYI I pulled a flamegraph from the failing run: top hot path shows kernel_select_score() and batch_coalesce() heavier than usual. link: https://perf.redwood/fg/34275
kevin: interesting — batch_coalesce hotness suggests the batching heuristic increased fragmentation. PR changed batch window from dynamic->aggressive. maybe it reduces coalescing which then forces suboptimal kernels.
mira: local bisect step output:
```
$ git checkout 8f3c9a4
$ run_perf_harness --suite=nightly-small --iterations=5
median_throughput=220 tok/s
$ git checkout parent
median_throughput=270 tok/s
```
so +18% when reverting that merge locally, consistent with CI.
olga: can we flip the flag that reverts the new scoring heuristic instead of reverting the whole PR? quick toggle would be: `enable_new_scoring=false` in runtime config.
jamal: tested toggle in staging — throughput recovers ~16% and p95 drops back. looks safe to do a temporary config rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: revert-scoring-flag -> staging (rollout 10% -> 100%).
kevin: I think we should hold the merge in the release train and do a targeted revert/flag rollback in prod. PR owner can rework batching logic.
mira: agreed. action items:
- olga to rollout config rollback to prod at 10:30 (olga)
- jamal to open a follow-up issue for batching/coalesce that includes flamegraph and perf deltas (jamal)
- kevin to coordinate with PR author on safer scoring formula (kevin)
- mira to run full nightly perf suite after rollback and post results (mira)
olga: rolling out flag rollback to prod now. will report back in ~15m :thumbsup:
mira: thanks — adding incident marker on dashboard and holding the release window until we have green nightlies.
kevin: also cc'ing infra on potential bigger rework for batch_coalesce algorithm — tagging @infra-team
ci-bot: nightly/perf-job :large_green_circle: post-rollback throughput within 2% of baseline; p95 restored. job id: nightly-34275-post
mira: closing loop — rollback worked, holding the merge from landing until follow-up lands and perf regressions are resolved. :white_check_mark:
